scope: Private live Photon room, Unity host and two independent Realtime peers. Aged capture fixtures exercise authenticated owner outcomes, deadline/checkpoint replication, actual Master handoff and movement clamping of remote avatars. Independent peers are not rendered Unity/Android clients.

checks.name: Only captured remote avatar is locked; observer has no challenge UI or timer
All peers receive one absolute 180-second room-clock deadline
Master change preserves elapsed timer instead of restarting it
Authenticated wrong-owner and stale results are rejected
One remote failure commits attack while retaining barrier and health until contact
Hit deducts exactly one captured-player heart and stuns only that player
Observer renders remote avatar's existing stunned animation
Owner movement packets cannot escape the host-confirmed knockback/stun anchor
Master change during stun preserves end time and serial-deduplicated damage
Checkpoint includes safe trajectory, five-second stun deadline and canonical health
Replayed outcome during stun cannot damage twice
Recovered player is released and no-repeat rotation selects another eligible player
Host expires barrier without owner response or enabled development controls
